script.title: The Emberkeeper
script.description: A crimson dragon shelters a removable sapphire egg beneath its lowered ivory-horned head. Broad scalloped bat wings, powerful crouching legs, bright watchful eyes and a curling armoured tail form a complete sculptural creature.
